category_title: Students with personal, social, or academic challenges who prefer work-based learning
student_description: This student struggles with traditional, abstract, desk-based learning, often viewing general subjects as irrelevant and reacting with disengagement or chaos. They are highly motivated by practical, visual, and concrete learning activities, thriving when academic concepts are explicitly tied to real-world vocational skills. They uniquely require a safe, non-traditional learning environment that values their personal experiences and utilizes physical artifacts rather than textbooks.

criteria.rationale: Isolated desks trigger negative associations with past school failures, whereas relaxed, non-traditional environments promote safe engagement.
criteria.check: The long-term plan includes modifying the physical learning space to include relaxed, non-traditional elements (e.g., couches, games) rather than relying solely on standard desks.

criteria.rationale: The student requires a predictable, safe environment with ample time dedicated to practical application rather than rushed theoretical instruction.
criteria.check: The long-term plan establishes consistent structural supports, such as extended course timelines, consistent teaching teams, or a deliberate shift toward workshop-based learning over classroom time.
